chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥasanī, from Mūsā ibn Muḥammad, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from one whom he mentioned, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, regarding the saying.
of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “And that if they had remained steadfast upon the way, We would surely have given them abundant water to drink.”
He says: “We would make their hearts drink faith,” and the way is the wilayah of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib and the awṣiyāʾ عليهم السلام.

key_terms.الطَّرِيقَةِ: the way; interpreted here as the path of rightful wilayah
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the successors appointed after him عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْإِيمَانَ: faith placed firmly into the hearts
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, whose wilayah is identified as the way
key_terms.مَاءً غَدَقًا: abundant water; interpreted here as a metaphor for richly bestowed faith
key_terms.وَلَايَةُ: wilayah; divinely ordained authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: What does “the way” in Qur’an 72:16 mean according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration explains the Qur’anic phrase about remaining steadfast upon the way as referring to steadfastness upon the wilayah of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام and the awṣiyāʾ عليهم السلام. The ‘abundant water’ is interpreted as faith with which Allah fills and nourishes the hearts.
